name: LCC Format Family
definition: An industrial-grade data format family that evolved from LCC11 to LCC22. LCC1 supports spatial chunking and Level-of-Detail (LoD) organization for progressive loading and large-scale scene visualization. LCC2 decouples data storage from LoD partitioning, organizing scene contents through a flexible hierarchical LoD tree that can index different payload types and storage backends. Together with compact binary layout and parameter quantization, it reduces storage by up to 90% compared with standard PLY files.
